title: JWT bearer disables audience validation, so any token from the IdP is accepted by every API
owner_hint: top committer: Michael Stonis (1 of 1 recent commit); no CODEOWNERS entry
rationale: AddDefaultAuthentication sets the per-service Audience then disables ValidateAudience, so tokens minted for another API or client ID tokens are accepted. The diff flips ValidateAudience to true, making the already-configured audience authoritative.
variants_checked: Audience values in Basket/Ordering/Webhooks appsettings match the IdP API resources; WebApp requests both orders and basket, so its token still works; no service forwards a token across APIs.
bypass_considered: ID tokens (aud = client id) and tokens for a different API are now rejected; a missing audience fails closed because ValidateAudience defaults to requiring one.
review_reason: One-line flip re-enables audience validation using the value already read from required config, matching the IdP's disjoint API resources. No in-repo flow needs a cross-audience token; remaining https-metadata and fail-open issues are separate findings.
